description: The plot illustrates the Loss Ratio (%) as a function of TFLOPs for five different model configurations: Vanilla, SepLLM (n=64), SepLLM (n=128), SepLLM (n=64, H), and SepLLM (n=64, H/T). The x-axis is labeled "TFLOPs" and uses a custom non-linear scale with evenly spaced tick marks labeled at specific values: 1e7, 2e7, 5e7, 1e8, 2e8, 3e8, 4e8, 5e8, 6e8, 7e8, 8e8, and 9e8. The y-axis is labeled "Loss Ratio (%)" and features a linear scale ranging from 94 to 100, with numeric tick marks at intervals of 1 from 94 to 99. The "Vanilla" configuration is represented by a solid purple line with upward-pointing triangle markers, remaining constant at a value of 100 across the entire x-axis range from 1e7 to 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64)" configuration is shown as a solid orange line with plus markers; it starts at approximately 98.3 at 1e7, rises to a peak of roughly 100.5 at 4e8, and ends at approximately 100 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=128)" configuration is depicted by a solid blue line with cross markers, beginning at roughly 97.1 at 1e7, increasing to about 99.9 at 2e8, and remaining relatively steady to end at approximately 99.8 at 9e8. The "SepLLM (n=64, H)" configuration is indicated by a solid green line with diamond markers, starting at approximately 97.5 at 1e7, climbing to a peak of about 100.3 at 6e8, and concluding at roughly 100 at 9e8. Finally, the "SepLLM (n=64, H/T)" configuration is represented by a solid red line with circular markers; it starts at 94.0 at 1e7, rises to a peak of approximately 99.1 at 4e8, experiences a decline to 98.4 at 5e8, and ends at roughly 98.7 at 9e8.
